#Run as bash script on cluster; non-R code is commented
##! /bin/bash
#module load R
#R --no-save
#Rscript -e '

library(Seurat);
AB14 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/14AB_all.RDS");
CD14 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/14CD_all.RDS");
EF14 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/14EF_all.RDS");
A16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16A_all.RDS");
CD16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16CD_all.RDS");
EF16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16EF_all.RDS");
GH16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16GH_all.RDS");
TATB16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16TATB_all.RDS");
TCTD16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16TCTD_all.RDS");
TE16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16TE_all.RDS");
TF16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16TF_all.RDS");
TGTH16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16TGTH_all.RDS");
LALB16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16LALB_all.RDS");
LCLD16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16LCLD_all.RDS");
LELF16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16LELF_all.RDS");
LGLH16 <- readRDS("/data/roomerb/seurat/16LGLH_all.RDS");
AB14;
CD14;
EF14;
A16;
CD16;
EF16;
GH16;
TATB16;
TCTD16;
TE16;
TF16;
TGTH16;
LALB16;
LCLD16;
LELF16;
LGLH16;
AB14 <- NormalizeData(AB14);
CD14 <- NormalizeData(CD14);
EF14 <- NormalizeData(EF14);
A16 <- NormalizeData(A16);
CD16 <- NormalizeData(CD16);
EF16 <- NormalizeData(EF16);
GH16 <- NormalizeData(GH16);
TATB16 <- NormalizeData(TATB16);
TCTD16 <- NormalizeData(TCTD16);
TE16 <- NormalizeData(TE16);
TF16 <- NormalizeData(TF16);
TGTH16 <- NormalizeData(TGTH16);
LALB16 <- NormalizeData(LALB16);
LCLD16 <- NormalizeData(LCLD16);
LELF16 <- NormalizeData(LELF16);
LGLH16 <- NormalizeData(LGLH16);
AB14 <- FindVariableFeatures(AB14, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
CD14 <- FindVariableFeatures(CD14, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
EF14 <- FindVariableFeatures(EF14, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
A16 <- FindVariableFeatures(A16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
CD16 <- FindVariableFeatures(CD16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
EF16 <- FindVariableFeatures(EF16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
GH16 <- FindVariableFeatures(GH16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
TATB16 <- FindVariableFeatures(TATB16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
TCTD16 <- FindVariableFeatures(TCTD16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
TE16 <- FindVariableFeatures(TE16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
TF16 <- FindVariableFeatures(TF16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
TGTH16 <- FindVariableFeatures(TGTH16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
LALB16 <- FindVariableFeatures(LALB16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
LCLD16 <- FindVariableFeatures(LCLD16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
LELF16 <- FindVariableFeatures(LELF16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
LGLH16 <- FindVariableFeatures(LGLH16, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000);
listall <- list(AB14, CD14, EF14, A16, CD16, EF16, GH16, TATB16, TCTD16, TE16, TF16, TGTH16, LALB16, LCLD16, LELF16, LGLH16);
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = listall);
list.anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(object.list = listall, anchor.features = features);
list.integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = list.anchors);
DefaultAssay(list.integrated) <- "integrated";
list.integrated <- ScaleData(list.integrated, vars.to.regress = c("nCount_RNA", "nFeature_RNA"));
list.integrated <- RunPCA(list.integrated, npcs = 90);
saveRDS(list.integrated, "/data/roomerb/seurat/cervthorlumb_all.RDS")
#'
